items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: Paul Barber and maybe thought his name was John Mac Murray.

ctx.x: Oh yes. We never didn't know much about Mac Murray. You happen to know what his real name... Some people say his first name was Mac and his last name Murray? No, that was his last name. His last name was Mac Murray. Now, I'm trying to think what was his first name.

I can't recall, but that was his last name. Paul Barber and maybe thought his name was John Mac Murray. I think it was John Mac Murray. I'm not sure. I'm not sure, but Mac Murray was his... Was his whole name when big names. Yeah, it was his last name.
Do you remember anything about John Veen? Oh, yes. I can remember John Veen. His son is up now.
